title: "012 — UI visual articulation pass"

## 012 — UI visual articulation pass {#sec-012}

> **Status:** standing — three mid-flight owner reversals, all landed before merge

**Goal.** A restyling-and-affordance pass over every screen: exactly one warm accent hue
reserved for actionable emphasis (buttons, links, active nav, focus rings, focused
composer); a three-step surface hierarchy — canvas, panel, raised card; the composer as a
centered rounded card whose launchers immediately create persistent artifacts anchored to
the conversation; a home page with resume affordances; hover-revealed row actions;
connector-line tree carets; one shared row-card grammar for chat/quiz/lab lists;
stagger-fade motion honoring reduced-motion preferences; skeletons only past ~300 ms.

**Why.** Nothing looked clickable without trial and error; hierarchy was encoded nowhere
perceivable; powerful features (branching, quizzes, labs) were tribal knowledge. Hard
governing principles bounded the how: articulation comes from hairline borders and subtle
shadows — edges, not brightness — because the low text contrast is intentional eye
comfort, so flatness must never be fixed by raising text contrast; exactly one sans-serif
type family; everything persists, reinforcing the standing rule that interactions become
artifacts on the main screen rather than ephemeral modals; compress chrome without
amputating facts; one accent system-wide, status colors stay status-only.

**Outcome & reversals.** Landed through the feature branch and merged with all ten success
criteria verdicts PASS and test gates green. Three reversals were caught by the pass's own
evidence discipline and landed before merge: (1) the proposed warm-charcoal night theme —
fully built as a token-level hue shift at constant lightness — was ruled down to achromatic
grays ("stick to the gray palette, keeping the accent"), reverting neutrals at digit-
identical lightness with the accent trio surviving as the sole saturated family — proving
hairline-edge articulation carries hierarchy without warmth; (2) the serif typography
experiment was introduced and cut within the same effort, confirming the sans-serif ruling;
(3) the five-seed home starter chip set was reduced to a single explore-new-topic chip,
the removed seeds duplicating what composer launchers and the resume card already cover.
Launcher persistence was demonstrated as real database rows, honoring the artifacts-not-
modals principle. A pre-existing cold-load bootstrap race was reproduced during testing,
pinned as predating the feature, and flagged for follow-up.

**Learnings.**

- Depth reads through edges and shadow, never brightened text; preserving exact lightness
  made the achromatic revert risk-free.
- Tokenize experiments so an owner veto is a cheap revert, not a redesign.
- A hard persistence principle keeps shiny new affordances from minting ephemeral state.
- Per-story evidence captured before sign-off meant reversals cost almost nothing and left
  an auditable trail.
